target: VII slider runtime stability and cross-template error audit
natural_destination: Exact local release candidate routes on desktop and 390px mobile, with later production verification requiring separate publication authorization

requirements.statement: Every selected rail tab displays only matching data and status.
Loading, failure, retry and retained-result states are bounded, visible and non-contradictory.
Every public page template family is scanned for runtime, network, blank-screen and responsive failures.
Existing search, gallery, navigation, content and availability capabilities remain unchanged.

risks.risk: Stale availability is presented as current for another date or tab.
A rail remains busy, fails without recovery or shows error and usable results simultaneously.
A shared repair breaks another world, route or viewport.
Slow SSR or a critical request creates a blank or misleading first viewport.

cases.preconditions: Holiday rail has verified initial cards.
cases.action: Switch through all holiday tabs, including rapid A-B-A selection and reload.
cases.oracle: Active tab, link, dates, cards and status agree; an older response cannot replace current data.

cases.action: Switch date and audience; exercise timeout/failure and retry.
cases.oracle: The control updates immediately, request settles within its budget, data identity matches selection, and failure leaves one clear recovery path.

cases.preconditions: Vacation and event rails have initial results.
cases.action: Switch every preset, use arrows and touch-style scrolling, then reload at desktop and 390px.
cases.oracle: All controls settle with matching data, selection persists correctly, and no sibling rail resets or moves unexpectedly.

cases.action: Open representative homepage, world, search, semantic landing, business, account, favorites, guides, legal, admin sign-in and unknown routes at desktop and 390px.
cases.oracle: No uncaught console error, failed critical request, blank first viewport, stuck busy state, missing global navigation or horizontal overflow remains unresolved.

cases.action: Exercise vacation filter, business gallery, language control, 404 recovery and browser back.
cases.oracle: URLs, counts, gallery identity, navigation and layout retain prior verified behavior.

cases.preconditions: Exact rail API query parameters are known.
cases.action: Measure cold and warm direct API plus page HTML requests.
cases.oracle: Status, cache, duration and payload ownership are recorded; errors are distinguished from client state defects.

out_of_scope: Authenticated booking or payment side effects
